Game Overview

In Leafino, the core idea is straightforward: embark on a lively adventure in Leafino, where you become a daring leaf navigating vibrant 2D landscapes. Master the art of the double jump to gather elusive orbs while skillfully avoiding dangerous fireballs. With escalating challenges across eight dynamic levels, embrace the excitement of strategic leaping and precision.
